note: ChatGPT web composer (2026-11-24). NOT measured live in this checkout: the CONTROL SEMANTICS come from two independent working implementations (herrkaefer/micpipe and bibryam/chatgpt-dictate), the LAYOUT ANCHORS come from public DOM reports of chatgpt.com. Re-verify every entry with probe.js while signed in, then fix here and re-run tools/build-extension.js + sync_extension.js and reload the extension. Three facts drive this file. (1) ChatGPT's dictation row has THREE distinct controls: the mic that STARTS the capture, 'Submit dictation' (a checkmark) that COMMITS the transcript, and 'Stop dictation' that DISCARDS it. The commit and the discard must never share a selector -- stopping through 'Stop dictation' throws the whole dictation away (C-ASR-4). (2) The composer is a contenteditable ProseMirror whose id/testid drift between releases, so every entry carries more than one candidate, and every candidate is ANCHORED to the composer form: a page-wide editable match would scrape the wrong box. (3) The blue Voice orb starts a live conversation, not a dictation, so it is excluded from the mic selector by its accessible label and its testid.
